name: Aider
summary: Open-source terminal tool for pair programming with LLMs on local git repositories.
description: Aider is an open-source command-line tool for editing code with large language models. It works inside a local git repository, maps the codebase for context, applies edits across files and commits changes automatically. It supports cloud models and local models. The project is free to install; users pay their model provider for API usage. The site reports more than 44,000 GitHub stars and 6.8 million installs.

howToUse.title: Open Aider
howToUse.description: Go to Aider and open Getting Started. It is an open-source, command-line way of editing code with large language models.

howToUse.title: Install and enter the repository
howToUse.description: Run python -m pip install aider-install, then aider-install, and change directory into your local git repository so Aider maps the codebase.

howToUse.title: Edit files and let it commit
howToUse.description: Ask for the code change. Aider applies each edit in the relevant files, then commits those changes automatically. Cloud models and local models both work; install is free and you pay the model provider for API usage.
